summary: The upgrade support matrix lists supported paths by RHEL version and deployment type; in-place major RHEL upgrades are not supported, so you must migrate AAP to a new RHEL environment.
questions: Can I do an in-place RHEL 8 to 9 upgrade on an AAP server?
Where is the AAP 2.6 upgrade support matrix?
How do I move AAP to a newer RHEL major version?
